findings.detail: z-index 5 is ignored: z-index only applies to positioned elements or flex/grid items, and this element is position:static with a non-flex/grid parent.
findings.fix: Set position:relative on the element (or make the parent display:flex/grid) so the z-index takes effect.
findings.avoid: Do not raise the z-index value — it is being discarded entirely, not losing a comparison.
